values.value: Learners can borrow items from their branch library. The loan period is {{Setting:Library_Loan_Days}} days unless the item sets its own. A loan can be renewed {{Setting:Library_Max_Renewals}} times before its due date. Late returns are fined {{Setting:Library_Daily_Fine}} per day up to {{Setting:Library_Max_Fine}}. A lost item is charged at its replacement cost. A learner with an overdue loan cannot borrow until it is returned.
